_comment: Estimator settings for cuVSLAM 17.0.0, identical for every dataset and run type.
Calibration is not here: it comes from configs/sensors/<dataset>.json.
odometry: library defaults (multicam_mode Precision, use_motion_model true, use_denoising false,
max_frame_delta_s 1.0) except async_sba=false. The sequences are fed as fast as the estimator
accepts them, so bundle adjustment must run in the tracking thread; with the background thread
the result would depend on how fast frames are pushed (upstream offline examples do the same).
slam: library defaults except sync_mode=true (same reason: loop closure and pose-graph
optimisation run inside track() instead of a background thread that offline feeding outruns).
